data.title: Novanta Shares Just Jumped And We’re Buying This Robotics Play
data.description: Just as early investors targeted foundational chipmakers like Taiwan Semiconductor (TSM), Nvidia (NVDA), and Broadcom (AVGO) at the start of the AI computing wave, investors are currently examining diversified industrial and sensor plays such as Regal Rexnord (RRX), Timken (TKR), Allegro MicroSystems (ALGM), Ouster (OUST), and STMicroelectronics (STM). During a recent episode of The AI Investor Podcast, hosts Eric Bleeker and Austin Smith took a closer look at Novanta, and shared why they are optimistic about the robotics manufacturer as an AI investment play to target in 2027.
